name: Factual Recall
description: Simple factual questions about specific entities or concepts.

name: Relationship Comparison
description: Comparing two entities on a specific attribute.
answer_template: Comparing {entity1} and {entity2}, {entity1} is {value1} while {entity2} is {value2} regarding {attribute}.

name: Multi-hop Reasoning
description: Questions that require connecting multiple pieces of information.
question_template: What is the relationship between {entity1} and the {attribute} of {entity2}?

name: Temporal Event
description: Questions about when specific events occurred.

name: Definition and Context
description: Detailed definition of a term within a specific domain.
answer_template: In the context of {domain}, {term} refers to {definition}.

name: Procedural Steps
description: Step-by-step instructions for a specific action.
